identity_audit.scope: all JRA full_runner records joined to full_field jra_public_reference races
identity_audit.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT h.jockey_ref,h.jockey,h.horse_ref,h.horse_name,h.trainer_ref,h.trainer FROM public.jra_lab_races r JOIN public.jra_lab_runs h ON h.race_id=r.id WHERE r.full_field AND r.source_kind='jra_public_reference' AND h.record_role='full_runner' AND h.source_kind='jra_public_reference'), a AS (SELECT 'jockey' AS kind,jockey_ref AS ref,jockey AS name FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 'horse',horse_ref,horse_name FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 'trainer',trainer_ref,trainer FROM f), b AS (SELECT kind,ref,count(*) AS rows,count(DISTINCT name) AS names FROM a WHERE nullif(btrim(ref),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY kind,ref), c AS (SELECT kind,count(*) AS all_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(ref),'') IS NOT NULL) AS populated,count(DISTINCT name) AS unique_names FROM a GROUP BY kind) SELECT c.*,count(b.ref) AS distinct_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE b.names>1) AS colliding_refs,coalesce(sum(b.rows) FILTER(WHERE b.names>1),0) AS rows_with_collision,max(b.names) AS max_names_per_ref FROM c LEFT JOIN b USING(kind) GROUP BY c.kind,c.all_rows,c.populated,c.unique_names ORDER BY c.kind
identity_audit.note: A # anchor is not an entity ID; exact root literal confirmed by separate GROUP BY. Distinct raw display names are not unique real persons; normalize only after official identity evidence. Name collision absence is not proof of native horse identity.
identity_audit.recovery: reject #, blank, javascript:void and non-entity anchors; official person-profile/registration links verified independently before any join; date-valid alias/tenure evidence; retain missing; no archive mutation. Do not estimate rider effect on invalid identity.
